description: Regression cases for the documented agent workflow contract; these fixtures do not claim to execute or prove a live model.

cases.situation: A tracked task is active, a substep has completed, and another concrete agent-owned repository action is executable now.
Hosted CI is unavailable or did not start, but implementation, investigation, deterministic tests, Git, or GitHub work remains agent-owned and executable.
A relevant agent-owned CI/build/check has started and is still pending. A bounded wait followed by another status poll is available.
cases.regression_example: CI is still running; tell the project leader to say follow CI later.

cases.situation: An agent resumes a tracked PR and relevant queued/running checks already exist for its current candidate.
cases.regression_example: Resume #343 by starting fresh workflows without first inspecting the six existing jobs.

cases.situation: A relevant CI run for the current candidate and validation purpose is still queued or running.
cases.regression_example: Start another equivalent GeoDot validation while the previous run is six minutes old and still running.

cases.situation: A GeoDot/world-renderer-only implementation iteration has no changed dependency or required final gate involving police/dispatch.
cases.regression_example: Run police dispatch regression merely because a new GeoDot renderer implementation was built.

cases.situation: An objective test is red and the failure can be diagnosed or repaired with available tools.
A human-executed Safe Check reports an objective failure and agent-owned diagnosis or repair remains.

An agent is about to present a Safe Check link, but merge-decision syntax, exact PR head, handoff contract, or an agent-executable objective prerequisite has not yet been verified green for the handoff candidate.
cases.regression_example: Ask the project leader to run Safe Check while the local objective chain can still fail before the required GeoDot stage.

cases.situation: Safe Check #343 failed on merge-decision parsing. The agent repaired the PR marker, but has not yet exhausted the objective/downstream Safe Check path or obtained HANDOFF_READY for the repaired candidate.
cases.regression_example: Fix **Merge recommendation** and immediately tell the project leader to run Safe Check #343 again.

cases.situation: Safe Check #343 failed because an irrelevant legacy PBF stage ran. The agent repaired that scope bug, but has not yet exhausted the remaining objective/downstream chain or obtained HANDOFF_READY for the repaired candidate.
cases.regression_example: Skip the legacy PBF rebuild and immediately tell the project leader to run the corrected Safe Check #343.

cases.situation: A repaired Safe Check candidate has completed all relevant agent-owned objective/downstream validation, the exact-head gate is green, HANDOFF_READY was emitted, and only the concrete perceptual check remains.
A small implementation edit is still in the debugging loop and a smaller deterministic validation can answer the current question.
All relevant available objective validation is complete and the only remaining requirement is a genuinely perceptual, interactive, hardware-specific, or otherwise non-automatable human check.
Requested scope, required objective validation, delivery metadata, and agent-owned cleanup are complete and no human-only check remains.
